summary: Full-stack testing of Brutal Wellness app. Backend 23/24 tests passed (1 test bug, not app bug - email lowercased correctly). Frontend: login, dashboard quick actions, wellness popup, leaderboard with filters, mood logging, profile, and logout all work. Fun Wall post-submit data-testid not found at /wall route.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased before storage - response email may not match input case (correct behavior, just undocumented)

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid=post-submit] not found within 30s on /wall route. Either selector missing, wrong route, or page renders differently. Liking/commenting could not be verified via UI.

action_items: Verify Fun Wall page has data-testid=post-submit on the publish button at /wall route. Add testid if missing or check route name (could be /funwall vs /wall).
Verify like-{id} and comment-submit-{id} testids render on Fun Wall posts.
critical_code_review_comments: Streak logic in /api/activities is buggy: when last_activity is < 30h and > 1min, it sets streak=max(streak,1) which never increments - streak appears stuck unless >36h gap (then resets to 1). Streak will never go above 1 via API.
POST /api/posts awards points but does not update level/wellness_score/last_activity unlike /api/activities (inconsistent gamification).
Leaderboard period=daily/weekly/monthly only includes users with activities in window - excludes top users by total points who weren't active. Likely intentional but worth confirming.
JWT_SECRET in .env is a literal default - should be rotated for prod.
/api/seed is a public POST endpoint with no auth - should be protected or removed in prod.
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded by backend on startup (5 demo users + 4 demo posts). Verified present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - reuse. Skip the test_register_new_user assertion bug (lowercase email). Fun Wall UI testids need verification - check /app/frontend/src/pages/FunWall.jsx for post-submit button testid and the actual route in App.js.
rca of the issue: Fun Wall post-submit not found likely due to: (1) testid named differently like 'wall-post-submit', (2) route is /funwall not /wall, or (3) button only renders after clicking a 'create post' toggle. Main agent should inspect FunWall.jsx.
